changes_made: Added import: from django.views.decorators.cache import cache_page
Added @cache_page(300) decorator to production_order_list view function
file_insights.impact: Performance optimization by caching the production_order_list view response for 300 seconds

patterns_discovered.description: Multiple decorators applied to view function (@cache_page followed by @login_required)
patterns_discovered.significance: Demonstrates understanding of Django decorator order - cache decorator placed before login_required to cache authenticated user responses

patterns_discovered.description: Using fixed 300-second cache duration for production list view
patterns_discovered.significance: Indicates deliberate performance tuning with a 5-minute cache window for list views

gotchas_discovered.description: @cache_page decorator must be placed BEFORE @login_required to function correctly
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: The implementation correctly placed @cache_page above @login_required, avoiding common Django caching pitfalls

gotchas_discovered.description: Production order list will be cached for 300 seconds - updates made during this window won't appear until cache expires
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider whether 5-minute cache is appropriate for production data or if cache busting is needed on order creation/updates

approach_outcome.outcome_summary: Successfully added caching decorator to production_order_list view in first attempt
approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Applied Django's @cache_page decorator with 300-second timeout to optimize view performance
approach_outcome.efficiency: Completed in single attempt with correct decorator placement and import

recommendations.recommendation: Review cache timeout duration (300 seconds) for production order list - verify if 5-minute cache is suitable for business requirements
recommendations.rationale: Cached list views may show stale data for critical production workflows

recommendations.recommendation: Implement cache invalidation strategy if production orders are frequently created/updated
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation will not reflect order changes until cache expires or is manually cleared

recommendations.recommendation: Consider caching other frequently-accessed list views with similar cache_page decorator pattern
recommendations.rationale: Demonstrates successful performance optimization pattern that could be applied elsewhere
